reviewItem.question: For "The Cilium cluster name is now validated to consist of at most 32 lower case alphanumeric characters and '-', start and end with an alphanumeric character", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether the configured Cilium cluster name violates the 32-char lowercase alphanumeric/'-' rule

proposed.statement: Cilium cluster name is now validated (max 32 lowercase alphanumerics or '-', starting and ending alphanumeric); bypass via upgradeCompatibility v1.15 or earlier, strictly enforced from v1.17.
